commands:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED_MAIN=d02bb3537be8a99762bf1264a4691ef06c7879ad
EXPECTED_BRANCH=ddc8c0042454b01ce14f58a4fb32544962267594
git fetch origin main agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path)" = "$EXPECTED_BRANCH"
git checkout -B agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
set +e
python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_chatgpt_relay_live_call.py' > /tmp/chat-relay-hardening-red.log 2>&1
RC=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/chat-relay-hardening-red.log
test $RC -ne 0
grep -E 'format_probe_metric_lines|delete_remote_branch_verified|2 != 1|AssertionError' /tmp/chat-relay-hardening-red.log >/dev/null
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo chatgpt_relay_hardening_red_verified=true
